provenance.designBrief: Low broad slate-blue wedge hull with closed cyan optical strip, rigid radio fins, suppressed central barrel module, two birdlike mechanical leg chains and two short underside telescopic clamp booms. This is deliberately a different machine silhouette from Meryl’s upright sensor-pod biped. No human face, hair, torso anatomy, organic hands or exposed pilot.
